metadata.title: Scientific Claim Registry (SCR): A Versioned Memory of How Scientific Answers Evolve — Framework v0.5.2: Corrective Release
metadata.description:
Corrective release. Use v0.5.2 instead of v0.5.1 (10.5281/zenodo.24325390) or v0.5 (10.5281/zenodo.24324283).

In v0.5.1, the first-mention timeline anchor of one question (SQ-LIP-000004) still pointed to a reference that the curator’s rules exclude from citation (author_ban, R-CLM-10). v0.5.2 removes it, and the tool that sets these anchors now skips excluded references. The rulebook records the cleanup of the project’s public repository history.

Dataset (otherwise identical to v0.5.1): 42 versioned questions, 514 evidence claims, 612 evidence records (601 verified, 4 disputed, 7 unverified), 876 question–claim links, 371 distinct DOIs. For the substance of this release line (registry kept current by its own Layer 1 surveillance loop; full-text risk-of-bias appraisal, R-CLM-18) see v0.5 and v0.5.1. It registers; it does not arbitrate.
